rationale: DYN has gapped down ~29.65% on massive relative volume (45.89x) with no available news headline to explain the catalyst, making it impossible to assess whether the move is fundamental (continued selling pressure) or overreaction (continued bounce). The last 5-minute candle closed at its low ($18.30) after a bounce from $17.00 to $18.99, suggesting fading momentum, but the 71 bps bid-ask spread introduces significant friction and the absence of EMAs/ATR data limits reliable stop placement. Without a clear catalyst and with extreme intraday volatility, the risk/reward is not sufficiently quantifiable to justify a position.
